unitTitle: Organise work, study and future plans
title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 5: Organise work, study and future plans

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Track the current schedule, the new plan and the next action. The speakers check a real constraint before deciding; the learner must use the schedule details rather than guess.

steps.title: A course after work
steps.body: Nadia asks a training-centre adviser about evening French classes.

examples.fr: Je vais suivre un cours de français le mois prochain.
examples.en: Nadia: I am going to take a French class next month.

examples.fr: Vous préférez une formation du soir ou un cours intensif ?
examples.en: Conseillère: Do you prefer an evening course or an intensive class?

examples.fr: Une formation du soir. Je travaille jusqu'à dix-sept heures.
examples.en: Nadia: An evening course. I work until five p.m.

examples.fr: Le groupe commence mardi à dix-huit heures. Vous êtes libre à cette heure ?
examples.en: Conseillère: The group starts Tuesday at six p.m. Are you free at that time?

examples.fr: Oui, mais j'ai un autre rendez-vous le premier mardi.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes, but I have another appointment on the first Tuesday.

examples.fr: Vous pouvez rattraper cette séance jeudi. Je vais vous envoyer le formulaire.
examples.en: Conseillère: You can catch up on that class Thursday. I am going to send you the form.

examples.fr: Merci. Je vais vérifier mon horaire, puis je vais valider mon inscription.
examples.en: Nadia: Thank you. I am going to check my schedule, then I am going to confirm my registration.

examples.fr: Très bien. Le groupe sera bientôt complet. La date limite est vendredi.
examples.en: Conseillère: Very good. The group will be full soon. The deadline is Friday.

steps.title: An interview time conflict
steps.body: Sam tells his classmate Nadia about a possible conflict.

examples.fr: L'entretien d'embauche est jeudi à quinze heures.
examples.en: Sam: The job interview is Thursday at three p.m.

examples.fr: Tu vas demander une autre heure ?
examples.en: Nadia: Are you going to ask for another time?

examples.fr: Oui. J'ai un quart de jour jeudi, mais je serai libre vendredi matin.
examples.en: Sam: Yes. I have a day shift Thursday, but I will be free Friday morning.

examples.fr: Tu vas envoyer un courriel aujourd'hui ?
examples.en: Nadia: Are you going to send an email today?

examples.fr: Oui, je vais expliquer le conflit d'horaire et proposer vendredi.
examples.en: Sam: Yes, I am going to explain the schedule conflict and suggest Friday.

examples.fr: Et si vendredi n'est pas possible ?
examples.en: Nadia: And if Friday is not possible?

examples.fr: Je vais demander un rendez-vous la semaine prochaine.
examples.en: Sam: I am going to ask for an appointment next week.

examples.fr: D'accord. Tu auras une réponse la semaine prochaine.
examples.en: Nadia: All right. You will get an answer next week.

steps.prompt: When does the evening course begin?
steps.explain: The adviser says the group starts Tuesday at eighteen hours.

steps.prompt: What will Mina do before confirming her registration?
steps.explain: Mina says she will check her schedule, then confirm.

steps.prompt: Why does Sam want to move the interview?
options: He has a day shift at the scheduled time.
He will start a French course.
steps.explain: Sam says he has a day shift Thursday and is free Friday morning.

steps.prompt: If Friday does not work, what will Sam do?
options: Ask for an appointment next week
steps.explain: He says he will ask for an appointment the following week.
